learning_method: Kev supervised imitation of constrained three-chunk forecast-return teacher; frozen conservative bandwidth derived only from past completed transfers, offline PSNR utilities and a terminal buffer-deficit penalty. Not online RL or true future-bandwidth supervision.
dataset_role: Same frozen v3 synthetic playlists, videos, network splits and reward scale. New candidate guard and planning labels are separately versioned. Future chunk sizes are available VOD metadata; future network samples, measured quality and answers never enter Kev input.
